references.text: Pharaoh ordered that the Israelites should no longer be given straw to make bricks, which led to the people having to scatter to gather stubble themselves.
The overseers announced Pharaoh's command that the people must provide their own straw, but the workload remained the same.
Describes the harsh forced labor the Egyptians imposed on the Israelites, including brickmaking and other hard work.
The people scattered around the camp to gather food, in a manner similar to how the Israelites scattered in Egypt to gather stubble.
Contrast between the temporary physical scattering in Egypt and the prophetic judgment against Egypt itself.
Theological contrast between Israel's 'scattering' in Egypt and God's judgment on Israel by scattering them among the nations.
